Class SiteDirectory

java.lang.Object
com.ads.SiteDirectory
public class SiteDirectory extends Object
Manages the status (UP/DOWN) of all sites. Tracks uptime history to validate read eligibility for Available Copies algorithm.

    • wasContinuouslyUp

      public boolean wasContinuouslyUp(int siteId, int sinceTime)
      Check if a site has been continuously UP since the given time. This is crucial for the Available Copies algorithm.
      Parameters:
      siteId - The site to check
      sinceTime - The time to check from (usually transaction start time)
      Returns:
      true if site was up from sinceTime until now

    • wasContinuouslyUpBetween

      public boolean wasContinuouslyUpBetween(int siteId, int fromTime, int toTime)
      Check if a site was continuously UP between two time points. Used for Available Copies algorithm validation: a site can only serve a version if it was continuously UP from the version's commit time through the transaction's start time (snapshot time).
      Parameters:
      siteId - The site to check
      fromTime - The start of the interval (inclusive)
      toTime - The end of the interval (inclusive)
      Returns:
      true if site was continuously UP throughout [fromTime, toTime]
